title: A plea to be called by his name
summary: Seven women take hold of one man and ask to be called by his name, offering to provide their own food and clothing.

explicit_facts.text: Seven women take hold of one man and say they will eat their own bread and wear their own apparel, asking to be called by his name to take away their reproach.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The women are gathered around and holding onto the man.
unspecified_visual_details: The people's appearances, clothing, ages, and expressions; the setting; the identity of the man and women.

spoken_dialogue.text: We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: seven women

spoken_dialogue.text: only let us be called by thy name to take away our reproach.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: seven women

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse presents a future condition; no identities or circumstances beyond what is stated are supplied.
prohibited_inventions: Do not assign identities or relationships to the man or women.
Do not depict the branch, cloud, smoke, fire, or tabernacle from later verses in this scene.

title: The branch and the fruit
summary: The verse foretells that the branch of the Lord shall be beautiful and glorious and that the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely to those escaped of Israel.

explicit_facts.text: The branch of the Lord shall be beautiful and glorious.
The fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely to those escaped of Israel.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A branch and fruit could serve as visual symbols for the verse's prophetic description.
unspecified_visual_details: Whether the branch and fruit are literal or figurative; their appearance and setting; the identities and appearances of those escaped of Israel.

narration.text: In that day shall the branch of the Lord be beautiful and glorious; the fruit of the earth excellent and comely to them that are escaped of Israel.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse is a prophetic description, not a narrated visible event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the branch as a supernatural visible being or event.
Do not invent the identities or appearances of those escaped of Israel.

title: Those remaining in Zion and Jerusalem
summary: Those left in Zion and remaining in Jerusalem are to be called holy; every one written among Jerusalem's living is included.
characters: people left in Zion and remaining in Jerusalem

explicit_facts.text: Those left in Zion and remaining in Jerusalem shall be called holy.
Every one written among the living in Jerusalem is included.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The named communities may be suggested through separate visual references to Zion and Jerusalem, without implying a particular census or ceremony.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance and number of the people; how being written among the living is represented; whether the two place references are shown together.

narration.text: they that are left in Zion and remain in Jerusalem shall be called holy,
every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem—

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse states a future condition and does not narrate a present-day event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent an inscription, book, ceremony, or named individuals.

title: Cleansing and judgment
summary: The Lord is described as washing away Zion's filth and purging Jerusalem's blood through the spirit of judgment and burning.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord shall wash away the filth of the daughters of Zion.
The Lord shall purge the blood of Jerusalem from its midst by the spirit of judgment and the spirit of burning.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The cleansing language may be presented through restrained symbolic imagery rather than as a literal scene.
unspecified_visual_details: The manner or visible form of cleansing, judgment, or burning; the appearances and presence of the Lord.

narration.text: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion,
and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse's purification language is not an explicitly narrated visible event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the Lord's appearance or invent a literal washing, fire, or bloodshed event.

title: Cloud by day, fire by night
summary: The Lord will create cloud and smoke over Zion's dwellings and assemblies by day, and shining flaming fire by night, as a defense over its glory.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord will create a cloud and smoke upon every dwelling-place of Mount Zion and upon its assemblies by day.
The Lord will create shining flaming fire by night.
The cloud, smoke, and fire are described as a defense upon all the glory of Zion.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The verse supports separate day and night views of cloud and smoke, and shining fire, over dwellings and assemblies.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance and extent of the cloud, smoke, and fire; the dwellings and assemblies; the nature of the defense.

narration.text: upon every dwelling-place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies,
a cloud and smoke by day
and the shining of a flaming fire by night;
for upon all the glory of Zion shall be a defence.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse explicitly describes cloud, smoke, and fire as divinely created signs and as a defense.
prohibited_inventions: Do not add people, danger, attacks, or a visible divine figure not described in the verse.

title: A refuge from heat and storm
summary: A tabernacle will provide shade from daytime heat and refuge and shelter from storm and rain.

explicit_facts.text: There shall be a tabernacle for shade in daytime from the heat.
The tabernacle shall be a place of refuge and shelter from storm and rain.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The tabernacle may be shown as shelter, with distinct visual suggestions of shade and protection from weather.
unspecified_visual_details: The tabernacle's form, materials, occupants, and precise location; the weather's appearance.

narration.text: there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat,
and for a place of refuge, and a covert from storm and from rain.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: This is a future description, not a narrated event with specified people present.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent occupants or a specific tabernacle design.
